ld.description: Dietary Supplement Certified Vegetarian 3rd Party Purity Tested Igen™ Non-GMO Tested Nordic Berries Getting children to eat a healthy, well-balanced diet-or even take a daily multi-can be a challenge for many parents. That's why we've developed a line of gummy vitamins for kids that help make simple acts of nutrition a little easier (and tastier). Rich in 10 vitamins and 2 minerals, including antioxidants vitamin C and beta-carotene, these delicious sweet-and-sour citrus multivitamin gummies support good nutrition and wellness as part of a healthy diet. Each serving of these tasty gummy berries provides children with an excellent source of twelve essential vitamins and minerals, including zinc and vitamins A, C, D3 and E, to help meet the increased nutrient demands of development during the early years. Ideal companion to any of our children's omega-3 products Nutrition your kids will love!

blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Ideal companion to any of our children's omega-3 products
paragraphs: Getting children to eat a healthy, well-balanced diet-or even take a daily multi-can be a challenge for many parents. That's why we've developed a line of gummy vitamins for kids that help make simple acts of nutrition a little easier (and tastier).

Rich in 10 vitamins and 2 minerals, including antioxidants vitamin C and beta-carotene, these delicious sweet-and-sour citrus multivitamin gummies support good nutrition and wellness as part of a healthy diet. Each serving of these tasty gummy berries provides children with an excellent source of twelve essential vitamins and minerals, including zinc and vitamins A, C, D3 and E, to help meet the increased nutrient demands of development during the early years.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: For 3+ years, four gummy berries daily, with. food, or as directed by your health care professional. Please ensure child chews each gummy berry thoroughly.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Organic cane sugar, organic tapioca syrup, purified water, pectin, natural flavor, citric acid, fumaric acid, and sodium citrate.
No gluten, milk derivatives, or synthetic dyes.
This product and its ingredients do not contain common GE genes or proteins.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Store in a cool, dry place, away from sunlight. Do not take if tamper-evident seal is broken or missing. Keep out of reach of children.
Consult with your physician before taking this product if your child has a known medical condition, or is taking medications
